::: {#def-intervention .theorem}
## Intervention equation

A deterministic function $h_{V_j}$ that returns a value in the range of $V_j$ from the variables preceding $V_j$ in a [topological order](#def-dag) of the [NPSEM](#def-npsem):

$$
h_{V_j} : \mathcal{R}(V_1) \times \dots \times \mathcal{R}(V_{j-1}) \to \mathcal{R}(V_j),
$$

where $\mathcal{R}(V)$ is the range of $V$. The arguments are measured variables; the error term $U_{V_j}$ is not among them.
:::
